name: ESAB
outlook:
What ESAB says to expect

  • Full year 2026: core sales growthESAB has updated its full-year 2026 outlook, which now projects total core sales growth of 13.1% to 13.3%, compared with the previous guidance of 11.0% to 14.0%.
  • Full year 2026: core adjusted EBITDAAs a result, the company has adjusted its core adjusted EBITDA forecast to a range of $603 million to $607 million, down from the previous $615 million to $625 million.
  • Full year 2026: core adjusted earnings per shareThe outlook for core adjusted EPS has been adjusted to a range of $5.28 to $5.33, from the prior $5.40 to $5.50.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
